blocks.prompt: 21. If the roots of the equation \((b - c)x^2 + (c - a)x + (a - b) = 0\) are equal, show that \(a, b, c\) are in A.P.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof quadratic equation aur A.P. ko jorta hai.
Equal roots (barabar roots) ka matlab hai discriminant zero hai. Humein is se \(2b = a + c\) tak pohanchna hai, kyunke yehi A.P. ki shart hai.
Plan: \(B^2 - 4AC = 0\) likhna, expand karna, perfect square pehchanna, aur natija nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((b - c)x^2 + (c - a)x + (a - b) = 0\) ke roots barabar hain (\(b \ne c\))
Saabit karna hai: \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hain, yani \(2b = a + c\).
Tareeqa: \(Ax^2 + Bx + C = 0\) ke roots tabhi barabar hote hain jab \(B^2 - 4AC = 0\) ho. Yahan \(A = b - c,\ B = c - a,\ C = a - b\). (\(b \ne c\) is liye ke warna yeh quadratic hi nahi rehti.)

Discriminant zero rakhein
\[(c - a)^2 - 4(b - c)(a - b) = 0\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula mein \(\sqrt{B^2 - 4AC}\) aata hai; yeh zero ho to \(\pm\) se koi farq nahi parta aur dono roots ek jaise ho jate hain.

Dono hisse expand karein
\[(c - a)^2 = c^2 - 2ac + a^2\]
\[4(b - c)(a - b) = 4ab - 4b^2 - 4ac + 4bc\]
Kyun: \((b - c)(a - b) = ab - b^2 - ac + bc\), phir 4 se multiply. Har term alag likhi taake sign ki ghalti na ho.

Minus kar ke ikattha karein
\[a^2 + 4b^2 + c^2 - 4ab - 4bc + 2ac = 0\]
Kyun: Doosre hisse ko minus karne se us ki har term ka sign badal gaya: \(-4ab,\ +4b^2,\ +4ac,\ -4bc\). Phir \(-2ac + 4ac = +2ac\).
Dhyan dein: Bracket ke aage minus ho to andar ki har term ka sign badalta hai; sirf pehli term ka nahi.

Perfect square pehchanein
\[(a - 2b + c)^2 = 0\]
Kyun: \((x + y + z)^2 = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx\) mein \(x = a,\ y = -2b,\ z = c\) rakhein to bilkul yehi chhe terms aati hain: \(a^2, 4b^2, c^2, -4ab, -4bc, 2ac\). Teen squares (\(a^2, 4b^2, c^2\)) dekh kar yeh shak karna chahiye ke yeh kisi bracket ka square hai.

Natija nikalein
\[a - 2b + c = 0\]
\[2b = a + c\]
Kyun: Kisi number ka square tabhi zero hota hai jab number khud zero ho. \(2b = a + c\) ka matlab hai \(b - a = c - b\), yani \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hain.

Ek tez tareeqa (tasdeeq)
\[(b - c) + (c - a) + (a - b) = 0\]
Kyun: Coefficients ka jama zero hai, is liye \(x = 1\) hamesha ek root hai (\(x = 1\) rakhein to yehi jama aata hai). Roots barabar hain to dono 1 hain, aur roots ka product \(\frac{a - b}{b - c} = 1\), yani \(a - b = b - c\). Wohi natija doosre raste se.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(2b = a + c\), is liye \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hain.
